joints.lm: Top line of the face: the dip where the forehead drops down to the muzzle, between the eyes.
joints.name: Stop (edge)

joints.lm: Highest point of the head's top line in front of the ears.
joints.name: Forehead top (edge)

joints.lm: The near ear's base, its LEFT-hand corner (toward the tail), where it meets the head or neck fur.
joints.name: Near ear, left corner (edge)

joints.lm: Very tip of the near ear.
joints.name: Near ear, tip (edge)

joints.lm: Centre of the near eye.
joints.name: Eye (centre)

joints.lm: Corner of the lips, at the back of the mouth line.
joints.name: Mouth corner

joints.lm: Front-most point of the lower jaw on the outline, under the nose.
joints.name: Chin (edge)

joints.lm: Underside of the head: where the jaw line turns up into the throat.
joints.name: Jaw angle (edge)

joints.lm: Top line right behind the ears: where the head's outline becomes the neck's.
joints.name: Back of the neck (edge)

joints.lm: Top edge of the shoulder blade: a little below and in front of the withers point; on a shaggy wolf, at the top of the shoulder mass.
joints.name: Shoulder blade top (bone)

joints.lm: Lowest point of the back line between the withers and the croup.
joints.name: Mid-back (edge)

joints.lm: Highest point of the rump's top line, over the hips, in front of the tail.
joints.name: Croup (edge)

joints.lm: Front line of the neck: where the throat meets the chest, under the jaw.
joints.name: Throat (edge)

joints.lm: Most forward point of the chest outline (in front of the breastbone).
joints.name: Point of the chest (edge)

joints.lm: Lowest point of the chest outline, just behind the near elbow.
joints.name: Deepest chest (edge)

joints.lm: Highest point of the belly line, just in front of the near thigh.
joints.name: Tuck-up (edge)

joints.lm: Back-most point of the rump outline, under the tail.
joints.name: Point of the buttock (edge)

joints.lm: Back point of the near elbow on the outline (the point of the elbow bone, olecranon).
joints.name: Elbow back (edge)

joints.lm: Front of the near wrist on the outline, level with the wrist joint.
joints.name: Wrist front (edge)

joints.lm: Back of the near wrist: the little pad bump behind it (accessory carpal pad).
joints.name: Wrist back (edge)

joints.lm: Where the back of the near front pastern meets the big pad, at the ground.
joints.name: Back of the front foot (edge)

joints.lm: Front tip of the near front toes, at the ground.
joints.name: Front toe tip (edge)

joints.lm: Front line of the near thigh, level with the hip joint (where the thigh meets the flank).
joints.name: Thigh front (edge)

joints.lm: Front of the near knee on the outline (the knee cap).
joints.name: Knee front (edge)

joints.lm: The heel point at the back of the near hock (top of the calcaneus), behind the hock joint.
joints.name: Point of the hock (edge)

joints.lm: Where the back of the near hind foot meets the big pad, at the ground.
joints.name: Back of the hind foot (edge)

joints.lm: Front tip of the near hind toes, at the ground.
joints.name: Hind toe tip (edge)

joints.lm: Where the top line of the tail leaves the rump (the built-in Tail base is the bone).
joints.name: Tail root top (edge)

joints.lm: Where the underside of the tail leaves the buttock.
joints.name: Tail root underside (edge)

joints.lm: On the tail's underside: the point where the tail is widest.
joints.name: Tail widest (edge)

joints.lm: End of the tail, fur included.
joints.name: Tail tip (edge)
